sabsa_vertical_stack.intent: Define business context, mission-critical assets, stakeholders, and business risk appetite.
Translate business attributes into security concepts and service objectives.
Develop technology-agnostic security logic, trust boundaries, and control logic.
Map logical controls to specific technologies, platforms, and deployment patterns.
Specify component-level configurations, integration patterns, and build requirements.
Operate, monitor, assure, and improve controls through governance and metrics.

traceability_model.objective: Provide end-to-end evidence from business attribute to operational control effectiveness.
governance_rules: Every security control must trace back to at least one business attribute.
Every accepted risk must cite business owner approval and residual-risk rationale.
Every technical exception must include an expiry date and compensating control evidence.
Every strategic security service must map to one or more board-level risk statements.
evidence_requirements: Run-time: control telemetry and effectiveness metrics
Governance-time: risk committee decisions and attestations

derivation_method: 1. Identify business attribute impact and tolerance thresholds.
2. Define business risk scenario with owner and consequence horizon.
3. Derive security requirement statements measurable at the conceptual layer.
4. Select logical controls that directly reduce likelihood or impact.
5. Map to physical/component controls considering feasibility and constraints.
6. Define operational metrics and governance checkpoints for assurance.
7. Evaluate residual risk and document business acceptance/escalation.

mapping_examples.risk_statement: Unauthorized exfiltration of regulated customer data.
derived_requirements: REQ-001: Enforce least privilege on sensitive data stores.
REQ-002: Detect and block abnormal outbound data patterns.
operational_assurance: M-02 Mean time to detect egress anomalies < 15 min

mapping_examples.risk_statement: Revenue channel outage during peak demand.
derived_requirements: REQ-101: Maintain defined service continuity objective.
REQ-102: Automate failover and validate restoration procedures.
logical_controls: LC-12 Incident severity policy and runbooks
physical_component_controls: PC-12 Immutable backup and restore workflow
operational_assurance: M-12 RTO/RPO dashboard attested by business owner

logic_steps.description: Define each business attribute with measurable business language (impact, tolerance, owner).
Attach explicit risk scenarios to each attribute, including event, actor, and consequence.
Convert each risk into security requirements with objective pass/fail conditions.
Implement layered controls logically then physically, preserving reference IDs.
Collect telemetry and audit evidence proving control effectiveness against original attribute intent.
Review residual risk with business ownership and formally accept, mitigate, or escalate.

traceability_validation_tests: Can a board stakeholder trace any control to a business attribute in under 5 minutes?
Do all risk acceptances identify business owner and expiration date?
Are security service KPIs linked to business attribute thresholds?
Can failed controls be tied to attribute degradation and decision logs?

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Data residency expansion under strict privacy law
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A global retailer enters a jurisdiction with strict data residency requirements. Engineering proposes rapid cloud deployment using shared tenancy. The business owner is worried about regulatory penalties but wants a 90-day launch.

perspectives.contextual: Business attribute BA-04 (regulatory demonstrability) and BA-01 (confidentiality) are both high-criticality.
perspectives.conceptual: Security service priorities: compliance assurance, data protection, and jurisdictional control.
perspectives.logical: Need logical separation, residency policy constraints, and legal hold traceability.
perspectives.physical: Select region-locked tenancy, key management in-jurisdiction, and policy-enforced data routing.
perspectives.operational: Continuous compliance attestations and audit-ready evidence mapped to legal obligations.

answer_options: A. Approve shared tenancy and rely on contractual clauses later.
B. Delay launch until all global standards are harmonized.
C. Define residency attributes, derive mandatory controls, launch only with traceable jurisdictional enforcement.
D. Delegate decision to cloud operations due to technical complexity.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: Strategic governance requires business-attribute-led control derivation and demonstrable traceability. Option C balances time-to-market with accountable risk ownership and enforceable controls.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-04/BA-01 -> risk of unlawful processing/disclosure -> residency and key-control requirements -> region-locked architecture -> compliance telemetry and board assurance.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: M&A integration with identity sprawl
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: After an acquisition, duplicate identities and privileged accounts exist across both firms. IT wants immediate directory consolidation. Business leaders demand uninterrupted operations.

perspectives.contextual: BA-03 integrity and BA-02 availability are at risk due to uncontrolled identity merges.
perspectives.conceptual: Required services: identity assurance, segregation of duties, privileged access governance.
perspectives.logical: Implement identity correlation, risk-based authentication, and SoD policy model.
perspectives.physical: Phased federation before hard merge; PAM controls for inherited admin accounts.
perspectives.operational: Weekly exception review with business application owners and risk committee oversight.

answer_options: A. Merge directories immediately and fix access conflicts later.
B. Freeze all privileged access for 30 days.
C. Use phased trust model with traceable role mapping and business-approved exceptions.
D. Let each business unit keep separate identity standards indefinitely.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C preserves continuity while maintaining attribute-led control integrity. Governance requires transparent exceptions and explicit business approval, not purely technical consolidation.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-03/BA-02 -> fraud/outage risk from identity errors -> IAM and SoD requirements -> phased federation and PAM -> audit trail for exception expiry and owner sign-off.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Ransomware pressure on manufacturing uptime
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A manufacturer experiences repeated ransomware attempts. Operations requests broad local admin rights to speed recovery. CFO prioritizes plant uptime and revenue continuity.

perspectives.contextual: BA-02 availability must be protected without undermining BA-03 integrity.
perspectives.conceptual: Resilience plus privileged control services required together.
perspectives.logical: Separate recovery authority from routine admin and enforce immutable restore workflow.
perspectives.physical: EDR containment, privileged elevation broker, offline/immutable backups.
perspectives.operational: Tabletop plus restoration drills with business-defined RTO thresholds.

answer_options: A. Grant permanent local admin to plant engineers.
B. Disable endpoint protections during peak production windows.
C. Implement just-in-time privilege and resilient recovery controls tied to uptime attributes.
D. Accept ransomware risk as a cost of doing business.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C aligns availability objectives with controlled privilege and auditable recovery capability. Governance must prevent emergency shortcuts from becoming systemic risk.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-02 -> outage risk; BA-03 -> tampering risk -> controlled recovery requirements -> JIT privilege + immutable backup controls -> resilience KPIs and executive risk review.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Third-party API dependence and opaque controls
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A critical customer workflow now depends on a third-party API. The vendor provides only annual SOC reports. Product leadership wants immediate go-live.

perspectives.contextual: BA-05 trusted ecosystem and BA-02 service continuity are primary.
perspectives.conceptual: Need third-party assurance and continuity service contracts.
perspectives.logical: Define dependency risk tiers and compensating verification logic.
perspectives.physical: Token scoping, API gateway policy, failover path and graceful degradation.
perspectives.operational: Continuous vendor risk scoring and contractual control attestations.

answer_options: A. Accept annual SOC as sufficient for all critical workflows.
B. Delay all integrations until direct vendor audits are possible.
C. Launch with tiered assurance controls, compensating telemetry, and business-owned residual risk decision.
D. Let engineering own third-party risk entirely.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C recognizes business ownership of supplier risk while implementing technical compensating controls and measurable assurance.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-05 -> supply-chain disruption risk -> assurance and resilience requirements -> gateway controls and fallback design -> vendor risk KPIs tied to business acceptance thresholds.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Insider trading surveillance in financial services
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A brokerage introduces a new trading platform. Compliance flags weak monitoring for privileged analysts who can access market-sensitive data before execution windows.

perspectives.contextual: BA-03 transaction integrity and BA-04 regulatory demonstrability dominate.
perspectives.conceptual: Monitoring, non-repudiation, and legal evidence preservation services are required.
perspectives.logical: Separation of duties, behavior baselines, and immutable event lineage.
perspectives.physical: UEBA, WORM log storage, strict session recording for privileged functions.
perspectives.operational: Cross-functional surveillance committee with legal/compliance sign-off on alert thresholds.

answer_options: A. Rely on annual ethics training without control redesign.
B. Block analyst access to all pre-trade data.
C. Derive surveillance controls from integrity attributes and enforce evidentiary traceability.
D. Delegate monitoring thresholds solely to SOC analysts.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C enables regulated business operations while preserving demonstrable integrity controls and legal defensibility.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-03/BA-04 -> market abuse and compliance risk -> surveillance requirements -> UEBA + immutable logs -> governance attestation on monitoring efficacy.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Hospital modernization with legacy clinical systems
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A hospital must connect legacy diagnostic systems to a new patient portal. Biomedical teams resist patching due to patient safety concerns.

perspectives.contextual: BA-02 availability and BA-01 confidentiality have direct patient and legal impact.
perspectives.conceptual: Clinical safety-aligned security service plus data protection service.
perspectives.logical: Compensating segmentation and strict data-flow constraints for legacy nodes.
perspectives.physical: Micro-segmentation, protocol break proxies, and monitored jump-host access.
perspectives.operational: Joint clinical-security governance for risk acceptance and maintenance windows.

answer_options: A. Keep legacy systems flat-networked to avoid downtime.
B. Force immediate full patching regardless of clinical impact.
C. Apply compensating controls tied to patient-safety attributes with explicit business and clinical ownership.
D. Exempt clinical systems from enterprise security governance.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C balances patient safety, confidentiality, and operational continuity through attribute-driven risk management and shared accountability.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-02/BA-01 -> care disruption and privacy risk -> compensating control requirements -> segmentation/proxy/jump-host pattern -> clinical governance sign-off and periodic review.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Board mandate for zero trust without business mapping
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: The board mandates 'zero trust in 6 months.' Security engineering proposes broad tooling purchases but cannot map them to business outcomes.

perspectives.contextual: Attributes must be prioritized by business value before architecture commitments.
perspectives.conceptual: Service definition should precede tool procurement.
perspectives.logical: Identity, policy, and telemetry models need explicit requirement lineage.
perspectives.physical: Tool selection follows validated control objectives and integration constraints.
perspectives.operational: Governance dashboard reports attribute impact, not tool deployment counts.

answer_options: A. Purchase full zero trust suite immediately to meet deadline optics.
B. Postpone initiative until all domains are fully documented.
C. Establish attribute-prioritized roadmap and phase controls with measurable business risk reduction.
D. Delegate program to infrastructure team without business owners.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C converts a slogan into accountable governance by linking investments to attribute outcomes and residual risk reduction.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: Prioritized BAs -> defined risk reductions -> requirement backlog -> phased logical/physical controls -> operational metrics presented to board risk committee.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Cloud cost optimization undermines logging
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: FinOps proposes reducing telemetry retention to cut cloud cost. Security warns this may impair incident investigation and regulatory response.

perspectives.contextual: BA-04 demonstrability and BA-03 integrity require evidentiary sufficiency.
perspectives.conceptual: Assurance reporting service and incident response service must define minimum evidence standards.
perspectives.logical: Data lifecycle controls need differentiated retention by risk class.
perspectives.physical: Tiered storage with immutable retention for high-risk events.
perspectives.operational: Quarterly evidence adequacy reviews with legal, finance, and risk owners.

answer_options: A. Cut all logs to 30 days to meet cost targets.
B. Keep all logs forever regardless of value.
C. Implement risk-tiered retention derived from business attributes and regulatory obligations.
D. Let FinOps finalize retention policy independently.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C provides defensible, business-owned tradeoff decisions with traceable evidence adequacy and cost control.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-04/BA-03 -> evidence insufficiency risk -> retention requirements by risk tier -> immutable/tiered storage -> governance attestations for cost-risk balance.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: DevSecOps acceleration with weak segregation
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A product unit wants developers to approve their own production deployments to speed releases. Audit has previously cited change-control failures.

perspectives.contextual: BA-03 integrity and BA-04 demonstrability are threatened by collapsed segregation.
perspectives.conceptual: Release assurance service and policy enforcement service are required.
perspectives.logical: Dual-control logic with risk-based approvals and traceable exception pathways.
perspectives.physical: Pipeline guardrails, signed artifacts, policy-as-code gates.
perspectives.operational: Change governance metrics include exception rate and post-release incident correlation.

answer_options: A. Permit self-approval for all low-risk changes by default.
B. Require CAB approval for every deployment.
C. Implement risk-tiered separation with automated policy controls and business-approved exception governance.
D. Move approval responsibility fully to SOC.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C balances velocity and control by applying SABSA-derived requirements and measurable governance over exceptions.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-03/BA-04 -> unauthorized change risk -> segregation and evidence requirements -> signed pipelines and gates -> metrics-driven governance and periodic recalibration.

cissp_calibrated_scenarios.title: Nation-state threat against critical infrastructure
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.prompt: A utility receives threat intelligence indicating targeted intrusion campaigns. Engineering requests emergency controls; executives fear customer impact from aggressive lockdowns.

perspectives.contextual: BA-02 availability is mission-critical, with BA-01 confidentiality and BA-03 integrity as co-drivers.
perspectives.conceptual: Threat-informed resilience and crisis governance services required.
perspectives.logical: Adaptive control states for normal, elevated, and crisis operations.
perspectives.physical: Network segmentation hardening, privileged session controls, and rapid isolation capability.
perspectives.operational: Executive crisis playbooks with pre-approved risk thresholds and emergency decision rights.

answer_options: A. Keep current controls to avoid service disruption.
B. Apply maximum lockdown immediately with no governance review.
C. Activate pre-defined adaptive control state model tied to business attributes and executive risk thresholds.
D. Outsource all decisions to external incident responders.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.governance_reasoning: C ensures rapid, accountable response with business-aligned thresholds and avoids both paralysis and uncontrolled technical overreaction.
cissp_calibrated_scenarios.attribute_traceability_logic: BA-02/BA-01/BA-03 -> targeted disruption and compromise risks -> crisis-state requirements -> adaptive controls and isolation mechanisms -> executive oversight with post-incident assurance.
